gym.label: Gym
sessions: Full-body strength with a lower-body focus: a squat or deadlift variation, a push, a pull and core.
Full-body strength with an upper-body focus: presses, rows, single-leg work and rotational core.
gym.beforeGolfRoundNote: Keep the leg work moderate: golf round tomorrow.

stretch.label: Stretch
routines: Hip flexor stretch: 2 x 45 s per side
Figure-4 glute stretch: 2 x 45 s per side
Hamstring stretch: 2 x 45 s per side

golf.competitionWarmUp: Putts from 1–2 m, a few chips, then full swings from wedge to driver. Know your first tee target before you get there.

roundObjectives.text: Full commitment to every selected target.
Use the pre-shot routine on every shot.
Track decision quality rather than reacting to the score.

wedges.label: Wedges

full: Warm up
Distance blocks: three distances in your range, five balls each
Random distances: a new target and distance every ball
moderate: Warm up
Distance blocks: three distances in your range, five balls each
Random distances: a new target and distance every ball
light: Distance ladder: three distances, three balls each

wedges.pressure: {n}-shot pressure test: one ball each, a new distance every time; count shots that finish within about 5 m
wedges.routine: Finish: {n} balls with the full routine, a new distance every ball

putting.label: Putting

full: Start-line drill from 1 m
Short putts from 1–2 m around the hole
Lag putts from 8–15 m, finishing inside 1 m
moderate: Start-line drill from 1 m
Short putts from 1–2 m around the hole
Lag putts from 8–15 m, finishing inside 1 m

putting.pressure: Pressure test: {n} putts from 1.5–2 m, one ball, the full routine on every putt; count the makes
putting.routine: Finish: {n} putts from 1.5–2 m with the full routine

short-game.label: Short game

full: Warm up: chips to one landing spot
Technique block: one club, one shot
Random lies and clubs
moderate: Warm up: chips to one landing spot
Technique block: one club, one shot
Random lies and clubs

short-game.pressure: Up-and-down test: {n} balls from different lies, one ball each, hole out; count the up-and-downs
short-game.routine: Finish: {n} balls from different lies with the full routine, holing out each one

range.label: Long game

full: Warm up with wedges, then a few mid-irons
Technical priority: slow rehearsals, then half and full speed
A new club and target every ball
moderate: Warm up
Technical priority: slow rehearsals, then half speed
A new club and target every ball
light: A new club and target every ball

range.pressure: Pressure finish: {n} balls, one each, the full routine, a new club and target every time; count the shots inside your target width
range.routine: Finish: {n} balls with the full routine, a new club and target every time

on-course.label: On-course practice
steps: Play 9 holes with one ball, on the course or a short course
Before each tee shot: pick the target and the safe miss
The full routine on every shot
Afterwards: note two good decisions and one to change
on-course.pressure: Score it: count the shots where you fully committed

scoring.label: Scoring + pressure

full: Warm up: chips and putts
Up-and-down game: 9 spots around the green, hole out, par 2 each; score against 18
Short-putt pressure: putts from 1 m until you make 10 in a row; a miss restarts the count
Record both scores
moderate: Warm up: chips and putts
Up-and-down game: 9 spots around the green, hole out, par 2 each; score against 18
Short-putt pressure: putts from 1 m until you make 10 in a row; a miss restarts the count
Record both scores
light: Up-and-down game: 6 spots, par 2 each; score against 12
Short-putt pressure: 5 in a row from 1 m

scoring.success: Both games played with the full routine; write down the scores.

comp-prep.label: Competition preparation

prep: Putting: start line, then 1–2 m with the full routine
Chips and pitches to feel, no technique changes
A few full shots with the full routine
Course plan: tee targets and safe misses for the hardest holes
Pressure finish: 5 putts from 1.5 m in a row

comp-prep.success: Leave feeling ready, not tired. No swing changes this close to the competition.

process.label: Routine and course plan

full: Warm up
Every ball with the full routine: a new club and target each time
Play your course on the range: the first six holes, shot by shot
Note where the routine slipped
moderate: Warm up
Every ball with the full routine: a new club and target each time
Play your course on the range: the first three holes, shot by shot
light: Routine rehearsal at home: ten slow swings, each with the full routine
Picture the first three tee shots of your next round
Course plan: safe targets for the hardest holes

process.success: The full routine on every ball, without rushing.

general.label: Practice

full: Warm up
Technique block: one thing at a time
Varied practice: change the target or lie every ball
moderate: Warm up
Technique block: one thing at a time
Varied practice: change the target or lie every ball
light: Technique block: one thing at a time

general.pressure: Pressure test: {n} attempts, one ball each, the full routine; count the successes
general.routine: Finish: {n} balls with the full routine
